name: parallax-layers
title: Parallax layers
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Layers that travel at different speeds while their parent crosses the viewport. Transform only.

meta.descriptionEs: Cada capa se desplaza a una velocidad distinta. Si se reduce el movimiento, se quedan quietas.

examples.title: Capas en paralaje
examples.description: Cada capa se desplaza a una velocidad distinta.

examples.title: Glosario
examples.description: Los seis términos de scroll, con demos propias.

api.name: layers
api.description: id, children, and speed or depth. 0 stays put. decorative hides a shape from assistive tech.

api.name: distance
api.description: Pixels of travel at speed 1, from entry to exit. Default 64.

api.name: container
api.description: Scrollport. Omit to use the window.

api.name: className / label
api.description: The root needs a height. Default h-64, which className can replace.

docs: Clean-room parallax. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. Movement is translateY from use-scroll-progress, so the layout box does not shift. The first paint matches the server. Reduced motion, via motion-preference, holds every layer at rest. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite use-scroll-progress, motion-preference, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
